text:
sam: Quick FYI from a local onboarding run: JS sampleapp with prefetch=8 queued pages and then hit a short 429 storm; memory ticked up. Repro: new acct, ~12 concurrent users, prefetch on. :grimacing:

amy: ouch. semaphore vs smoothing again?

sam: yeah. go/py use token-bucket smoothing; js allows prefetch slots to keep getting handed out after 429s. config: `prefetch=8, client_window=16, max_concurrency=10`. logs: repeated `WARN page-fetch status=429`.

kelvin: short-term mitigation: clamp prefetch to `max(1, Math.floor(client_window/4))` and reduce effective prefetch by 50% for 30s after sustained 429s. Add jittered exponential backoff on retries.

amy: agree. add `DEBUG_PREFETCH=true` and header `X-RW-Prefetch-Debug: true` to surface inflight/pending counts for support.

sam: prototyping clamp now. I'll open a draft PR with the change + a synthetic e2e that fakes 429s so CI can validate.

ci-bot: CI flaky test in `devex/sampleapp` prefetch_flow. See https://ci/reports/5101

kelvin: also filing an SDK parity ticket to align JS with smoothing or at least provide a pluggable prefetch controller: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/1055

amy: short-term docs note: recommend `prefetch: 1` for onboarding small orgs. Long-term: SDK change.

sam: PR draft coming, ETA today EOD. Thanks. :thumbsup:
